summary: S08 (PDF export, publishing, sharing, web viewer, published documents and schema). VV is a full generation behind. TV v2.155-v2.172 split drawing output in two. A publisher (LE/65, 7 files) bakes each drawing once on the authoring machine into tiered WebP rasters, linework SVGs, element JSON and a baked PDF. A reader (top-level 52, 11 files) only shows those files, and a shared contract (top-level 53, 4 files, schema 1) links the two. Share links (LE/66, 7 files) build on top. None of this exists in VV. VV's web viewer (1.1.0) still calls SetSheet and renders every viewport on the reader's phone (ModeController:539/779/785), and its dock PDF button runs the full exporter there: the exact iPhone/iPad crash TV v2.155 fixed. PdfExporter is TV 1.12.0 vs VV 1.2.0. Only the 1.11.0 'FAST' packing (the Chrome/Android garbling fix) and the publish options are independent; the rest depends on TV-only systems from other slices (PaintOrder, ShapeRings, SheetImages, rotation, fog, site plans, ModelSource). VV prints non-embedded Helvetica (no PdfFonts), contrary to its own D14 (Open Sans) and to its screen face. jsPDF sits in the legacy 35 folder (byte-identical to TV's vendored 4.1.0). Transport (DIV-4): VV must publish into VaApps/Projects/{folderId}/06__Layout__PublishedDocuments through new key-authenticated routes on whitecardopedia-editor-api: raw file, list and document-scoped delete, with no global build-manifest bump. It also needs a Flask blueprint mirroring ProjectVision__TrueVisionPublished__Api__.py and a 03__AppUtils client. Critical blocker found: the Whitecardopedia sync's image purge lists the project prefix with no delimiter. It would delete every published picture (and likely thumbnails and snapshots) on the next sync. Other VV seams: reader URLs on localhost (VV's ResolveAssetUrl falls back to GitHub Pages, and Flask returns index.html with 200 for missing files); ProjectLoader facades; DocumentId; the loader's first-drawing wait; Share__Open started lazily by the loader; the na-app-scene-ready event. Twelve decisions are listed, the main ones fonts, DocumentId, publish entry point (no Drawing Register in VV), link form (no s/ resolver needed: ?project=<code> resolves through VV's master index), and storage location.

findings.title: VV web viewer renders drawings and builds PDFs on the reader's device; TV's published-document system is absent
findings.detail: TV v2.155 split the authoring renderer from a reader that computes nothing (52 reader, 53 schema, 65 publisher) to stop iPhone, iPad and Pixel crashes. VV's viewer (v2.58.0, ported from TV v2.65) still calls SetSheet on Enter and on loaded/active sheet changes. Every viewport is therefore rendered on the reader's device, through VV's composer (DIV-1). The dock PDF button runs the whole exporter on the phone. None of 52, 53 or 65 exists in VV.
findings.recommendation: Port the published system as one programme (WP-S08-05..10): schema, reader, VV transport, publisher, then switch the viewer to published drawings. This is the highest-value alignment in the slice: a parity gap and a reliability fix at once.
findings.evidence: VVM/LE/05__Core__ModeController/Na__LayoutEditor__ModeController__.js:539,779,785; VVM/LE/80__Feature__WebViewer/Na__LayoutEditor__WebViewer__.js:83,289-296; TV ModeController:747-754,1124-1137; TV DEVLOG v2.155 lines 1266-1363
findings.vv_adaptation: Transport, URL resolution, DocumentId, identity strings and loader seams as itemised in the other findings

findings.title: Whitecardopedia project sync would delete every published picture (and likely thumbnails/snapshots) from R2
findings.detail: na_purge_stale_r2_images lists VaApps/Projects/{folderId}/ with no Delimiter. That makes it recursive, and it is also unpaginated (first 1,000 keys). It deletes every .png/.jpg/.jpeg/.webp whose bare name is not a top-level local image (iterdir), and it runs on every sync. Published tiers, print PNGs and fog masks would vanish, leaving manifests that name missing files. By the same reading it threatens PresentationMode/Thumbnails and LayoutEditor/Snapshots. Read, not run; the bucket was not listed.
findings.recommendation: Before VV's first R2 publish: purge top-level keys only (Delimiter='/') and paginate. Optionally also skip 06__Layout__PublishedDocuments/, LayoutEditor/, PresentationMode/ and 00__*. This is a shared Vale pipeline, so Adam approves (D-S08-09).
findings.evidence: WCP/Tools__DevUtils/AutomationUtil__SyncSingleProject__ToCloudAndWeb__Main__.py:645-656 (keep-set from iterdir), :659-680 (purge; list_objects_v2 Prefix only at :667), called :926 and :959; R2_BASE_PREFIX :101
findings.vv_adaptation: VV-only pipeline; TV avoids this by skipping 00__ folders and never sweeping published roots

findings.title: 53__Data__Layout__PublishedSchema (the shared publish/read contract) is absent
findings.detail: 4 files: JSON (189 lines), Paths 1.1.0 (678), Version 1.0.0 (172) and README (99). They hold every folder and file name, the element kinds, the tier table (Fit 2, Read 6, Detail 12, Print 20 px/mm), the version gate (schema 1; refuses newer and older with a human reason), the Stamp and ShareLinksPath (v2.166, additive). The readable schema is TV's AA00 example folder in the project portal. Top-level number 53 is free in VV.
findings.recommendation: Port at top level 53. Keep keys, names, tiers and Version__Schema=1 verbatim, so both apps' publishers and readers stay compatible and one test shape serves both. Change only SchemaRef, MinReader, ByApp and the reason strings, plus the comments that name 30__TrueVision__AppContent.
findings.evidence: TVM/53__Data__Layout__PublishedSchema/Na__PublishedSchema__.json (Version__Schema 1, MinReader v2.142.0); Paths__.js:262 'relative to a project's 30__TrueVision__AppContent'; Version__.js Stamp Publish__ByApp 'TrueVision3D Layout Editor'
findings.vv_adaptation: Meta__SchemaRef -> VV example folder; Version__MinReader -> the VV release that ships it (informational only); Publish__ByApp and reasons say ValeVision3D; comments name the VV project folder as the root

findings.title: 52__System__Layout__PublishedDocuments (the reader) is absent
findings.detail: 11 files, 3,998 lines: Document (loads the index, then the manifest, sheet and element files, and builds one SVG string with progress events), Urls (R2 first on the live site, repository first on localhost, a 404 never retried), Viewports (tier ladder, 128 MB decoded budget, no decode retry), Sheet/Paint/Elements/Unpublished (mark emitter, grey mask), LoadingScreen (v2.156), Config, CSS and README. It imports only 53 and ProjectLoader, and its test proves no renderer is reachable.
findings.recommendation: Port at top level 52. Verbatim except Na__PubDoc__Urls__ (VV project resolution; on localhost the Flask copy first) and Na__PubDoc__Config__.json (Sheet__FontFamily = the VV authoring face; prefixes). Leave Na__PubDoc__Styles__Main__.css unlinked, as TV does.
findings.evidence: TVM/52__.../README__PublishedDocuments__.md; Na__PubDoc__Urls__.js:142-207; Na__PubDoc__Config__.json PubDoc__Sheet__Config.Sheet__FontFamily (must match the authoring side)
findings.vv_adaptation: Urls.FromPage/For seams; Config Sheet__FontFamily per D-S08-03; console prefixes; README paths

findings.title: Publisher orchestration (Publish__ 1.1.0 + Publish__Config) is absent
findings.detail: Publish__.js (707 lines) does the whole publish: per-sheet status; a new revision archived to a zip (never overwritten); sheet and element files; per-viewport bake; the baked PDF (strict:false, FAST); the manifest last; a document-scoped prune. With R2 ticked it uploads, lists back and checks sizes, uploads the manifest, then prunes. Orphans are retired only on a full publish. The unpublished file and share record go just before the index, and the index goes last. Config: PushToR2Default false, BakePdf, RetireOrphans, SpecLoadTimeoutMs, labels.
findings.recommendation: Port into LE/65__Feature__DocumentPublishing (the number is free in VV) with the VV seams listed. Treat it as authoring-only, never built for a reader.
findings.vv_adaptation: appVersion floor and Behaviour__AppVersion = VV release; console prefix; Project__Folder = VV folderId; Project__ContentFolder = 06__Layout__PublishedDocuments; failure text names the Sheet panel's Drawing No.

findings.title: Bakers Publish__Raster, Publish__Sheet and Publish__Viewports are absent and import TV-only exports
findings.detail: Raster 1.0.0 cuts one render into four tiers by halvings, makes the fog mask and SHA-256 names, and refuses a browser that writes PNG for WebP. Sheet 1.0.0 writes element files with resolved keys and per-layer editor SVG, plus portable images. Viewports 1.1.0 writes the picture, linework SVG, fog masks and holed site faces (v2.160). Sheet and Viewports import PaintOrder, BuildLayerPrimitives, BuildViewportFrame, ShapeRings, FloorAreas, RenderFogForExport, SitePlanDrawing and IsSitePlanViewport. VV has none of these, so a verbatim copy fails to link.
findings.recommendation: Port verbatim after the owning slices deliver those exports (preferred). Otherwise stub only fog and site plans (D-S08-11). Publishing must run in Chrome or Edge.
findings.evidence: TVM/LE/65__.../Publish__Sheet__.js:58-71 imports; Publish__Viewports__.js:65-86 imports; Publish__Raster__.js:151-167 (WebP check)

findings.title: Publish__Transport must be re-pointed at VV's Flask blueprint and VV's worker
findings.detail: TV Transport 1.0.0 posts to /api/truevision/published/* on the 8090 server and reaches R2 through Na__CfApi__UploadPublished, ListPublished and DeletePublished (the generic /r2/*). VV has neither. TV's R2Ready() is synchronous and is called without await (Publish__.js:585 and the share manifest), whereas VV's worker config arrives asynchronously from Flask GET /api/editor-config.
findings.recommendation: Port with identical exports: API constant /api/valevision/published, R2 calls through the new VV client util. Prefetch the worker config in LocalReady so R2Ready answers synchronously from the cache. The restart hint names WCP/server.py.
findings.vv_adaptation: Local API base and R2 client swapped; sync R2Ready from a cached config

findings.title: VV worker needs published-document routes (file, list, scoped delete) in VV's own storage
findings.detail: whitecardopedia-editor-api has only semantic routes. Its asset route takes JSON base64 (25 MB cap), is guarded to Thumbnails/Linework/Snapshots, sets no-cache and bumps the global build manifest. Publishing needs raw files up to tens of MB, a list with sizes, a scoped delete and per-class Cache-Control. Key: VaApps/Projects/{folderId}/06__Layout__PublishedDocuments/<rel>. Routes: POST .../published/file?path= (raw, about 95 MB), POST .../published/list {document,cursor} and POST .../published/delete {document,paths}.
findings.recommendation: New handler CloudflareHandler__PublishedDocuments__.js, with routes in index.js before the greedy save route, using the existing X-Editor-Api-Key and CORS helper (POST avoids a CORS change). Enforce the document scope server-side. Adam deploys with wrangler.
findings.vv_adaptation: Semantic, authenticated routes instead of TV's generic open /r2/*; content type from the extension; immutable for __<10 hex> names, else max-age=60 must-revalidate

findings.title: VV Flask mirror for local filing (list, read, write, archive, prune)
findings.detail: TV's local filing is ProjectVision__TrueVisionPublished__Api__.py (448 lines): segment, project and extension guards, byte sniffing, atomic temp-then-rename writes, archive zips that are never overwritten, document-scoped prune, 2-digit year, 256 MB cap. VV's Flask registers only the scrapbook blueprint. server.py get_project_path joins ids containing '/' with no inside-the-tree check.
findings.recommendation: New WCP/Server__ValeVisionPublished__Api__.py, a port of TV's: /api/valevision/published/{list,file,archive,prune} with the same query shape, YEAR ^\d{4}$, root Projects/{year}/{folder}/06__Layout__PublishedDocuments and its own guarded resolver. Register it in server.py and restart.
findings.vv_adaptation: Route prefix /api/valevision/published; 4-digit year; no content sub-folder; VV project folder pattern

findings.title: A published write must never bump VV's global build manifest
findings.detail: The ProjectAsset and DrawingNotes handlers call na_write_build_manifest, which rewrites the global VaApps/Index/Na__BuildVersion__Manifest__.json. ProjectLoader appends ?v=<buildVersion> to every project.json and GLB URL. Each bump therefore makes every Vale client re-download its models, across all projects. Published files are content-hashed or short-lived JSON and need no bump.
findings.recommendation: The published handler must not call na_write_build_manifest. Set Cache-Control per file class instead: immutable for hashed names, 60 s must-revalidate for the index, manifests and element files.

findings.title: VV has no document id, yet it names every published folder, archive and share fallback
findings.detail: TV's Na__LeModel__GetDocumentId returns the stored Sheet__Fields__DocumentId, else project code + phase + number (SheetRecords 1604-1608). Published folders, archive zips, manifests, index rows, the WebViewer and the Share fallback all use it. VV has only the Drawing No. (stored, else '<code>-<order>'), no phase and no register. The PDF exporter already diverges here (VV fields.DrawingNumber vs TV fields.DocumentId).
findings.recommendation: Decide before the first publish (D-S08-06). Interim: a VV Na__LeModel__GetDocumentId that returns the sanitised stored Drawing No., with the existing default. Move to TV's composition only together with the register/phase port.
findings.vv_adaptation: Adapter returning the drawing number; must pass the schema segment regex

findings.title: PdfExporter TV 1.12.0 vs VV 1.2.0
findings.detail: VV lacks: 1.0.3 design phase (v2.32), 1.2/1.12 site plans (v2.49, v2.160), 1.4 Open Sans, 1.6 fog (v2.94), 1.7 Layers-list paint order with per-viewport frames (v2.106), 1.8 sheet pictures (v2.116), 1.9 turned viewports (v2.138), 1.10 overspill regions (v2.143), 1.11 FAST packing and options (v2.155), the LoadLibrary export and returnPromise save. VV's header log stops at 1.2.0, though it carries TV 1.1.0, 1.3.0 and 1.5.0 behaviour.
findings.recommendation: Two steps. Now: the independent 1.11.0 parts (WP-S08-02). Later: port_whole_reapply_vv once PaintOrder, MarkupBridge 1.20, SheetChrome 1.14, ShapeRings, Hatch, SheetImages, ViewportRotation, fog, site plans and ModelSource land (WP-S08-14).
findings.evidence: drift_all: 585 vs 339 lines, 364 diff; TV PdfExporter__.js:44-130 DEVELOPMENT LOG, :386-399 AddPicture, :495-541 BuildDocument; VV :38-58, :266-297
findings.vv_adaptation: Console prefix; subject 'ValeVision3D sheet'; 42__System__DrawingViewCore path; filename code = fields.DrawingNumber until D-S08-06

findings.title: PdfFonts absent: VV prints non-embedded Helvetica (deliberate divergence to revisit)
findings.detail: Ledger row 1169 calls this deliberate. But VV D14 says Open Sans 300/400/600; VV's UI and annotation face is Open Sans; title block cells were re-measured in Helvetica; and a non-embedded face is substituted by each reader (TV v2.69: 'Same file, three faces'). The published reader's Sheet__FontFamily must equal the authoring face. No Vale typeface files exist in the repositories searched.
findings.recommendation: D-S08-03 option (a): port PdfFonts and embed Open Sans from a VV-owned copy. Make the sheet face Open Sans-first, re-measure the title block cells, and wire SheetChrome measuring, SpecPdf and the exporter (WP-S08-03). A Vale face needs font files and a licence first.
findings.evidence: VV ledger:121,1169; VV PLAN:62 (D14); VVM/LE/10__.../SheetChrome__.js:19,130,151-185; VV AppConfig Style FontFamily 'Helvetica, Arial, ...'; TV DEVLOG v2.69 9676-9775
findings.vv_adaptation: Font paths to a VV-owned TTF location (not NA's na-apps CommonFonts); console prefix; VV title block fixture re-measured

findings.title: WebViewer 1.1.0 vs 1.2.0, plus the unlogged v2.155/v2.156 published-reader integration
findings.detail: VV lacks: ShowPublished, EnsureIndex, WatchZoom (tier swap), Release and the late-show token guard; the PDF button opening the baked PDF ('This drawing has no published PDF yet.'); the PubLoad cover calls; Share in the dock (1.2.0); the register document. TV's header logs only 1.0.0-1.2.0 (the published changes went in unversioned), and TV imports IsSitePlanSheet without using it.
findings.recommendation: port_whole_reapply_vv from TV 1.2.0, keeping VV's Documents() (no site-plan split; no register until ported) and dropping the dead import. Bump VV to 1.2.0 with a full log.
findings.evidence: drift_all 706 vs 496, 254 diff; TV WebViewer__.js:84-111 imports, 323-359 Pdf/Share, 492-605 published path; VV :83,:289-296,:397-403
findings.vv_adaptation: VV Documents(); no register; no IsSitePlanSheet; console prefix

findings.title: ModeController must never render a sheet in the viewer
findings.detail: VV's Enter (:539) and OnSheetsChanged (:779 loaded, :785 active) call SetSheet in viewer mode. TV 1.30.0 guards both. On the second path 'a phone was still rendering every viewport of the sheet it had just been told to show published'. TV also keeps its first-open veil editor-only.
findings.recommendation: Carry these seams into VV's ModeController with WP-S08-10: viewer -> ShowDrawing only, no SetSheet, no Fit; OnSheetsChanged viewer branch from TV :1124-1137. The ModeController itself belongs to the mode-controller slice.
findings.vv_adaptation: VV has no first-open veil in Enter; see S08-F26 for the loader wait

findings.title: 66__Feature__DocumentSharing (share links and the share-link record) is absent
findings.detail: 7 files (Links 418, Manifest 487, Button 454, Open 364, Config 61, CSS 220, README 112), v2.166. Keys are permanent rules in code: sheet id, Statement_<id>, Specification, Register; parsing is liberal. The record PublishedDocuments__ShareLinks__.json is written at publish just before the index. The buttons copy before any await (Safari). Open shows a reader the document before the 3D model loads.
findings.recommendation: Port Links and CSS verbatim. Adapt Manifest, Button, Open, Config and README: no statements or register; VV link base; Open started by the loader. Keep the reserved key constants so later features add no new key forms.
findings.evidence: TVM/LE/66__Feature__DocumentSharing/README__DocumentSharing__.md; Share__Links__.js:76-110 key constants; Share__Manifest__.js:79-109 imports; TV DEVLOG v2.166 466-553
findings.vv_adaptation: Statement imports and listener removed; register kind omitted; Link__BaseUrl/QueryPattern VV; missing-drawing fallback opens the first sheet or the specification

findings.title: Keep VV's authenticated, semantic worker; do not copy TV's open generic /r2/* model
findings.detail: TV v2.169 found na-truevision-api has no authorisation. Every /r2/* route runs for any caller; writes and deletes are checked only for the NaProjectPortal/ prefix; deploy.bat deploys without --env production, so CORS echoes every origin. VV's worker requires X-Editor-Api-Key on everything but health, and the key reaches a browser only from the local Flask /api/editor-config.
findings.recommendation: Record DIV-4 as permanent: VV publishes through semantic, key-authenticated, path-guarded routes with server-side document scoping. Offer TV the VV pattern as a hardening back-port (Adam's call).
findings.evidence: TV DEVLOG v2.169 262-271; TV worker CloudflareWorker__Main__.js getAllowedOrigin (development allows all); WCP/CloudflareWorker/src/index.js:112-116,148; WCP/server.py:334-361

findings.title: Publish entry point: TV opens Publish Drawings from the Drawing Register, which VV lacks
findings.detail: Publish__Panel 1.1.0 (285 lines, styles injected inline) is imported only by Register__Editor__.js (import :90, button :539). VV has no 51__Feature__DrawingRegister. VV's Layout Editor Dev section already hosts the localhost-only 'Bake Snapshots and Linework' (:342) and 'Export PDF' (:345).
findings.recommendation: Port the Panel verbatim. Interim entry: a 'Publish drawings...' button in the VV LE Dev section via dynamic import (authoring only). Move it to the register bar if and when the register is ported (D-S08-04).

findings.title: FAST picture packing (PdfExporter 1.11.0): independent and needed now for Chrome/Android
findings.detail: Given compress:true, jsPDF uses the Paeth predictor. Chrome's and Android's PDF engine then paints black blocks and streaks over a picture past about 60 MB decoded (PS01 D01, 70.3 MB). TV packs every viewport picture 'FAST' (the Sub predictor), overridable by options.pictureCompression, and the publisher relies on these options. VV calls doc.addImage(..., 'PNG', ...) with the default.
findings.recommendation: Port AddPicture, the options plumbing (strict, pictureCompression), the LoadLibrary/EnsureJsPdf split and export, and the awaited save now (WP-S08-02).
findings.evidence: TV PdfExporter__.js:375-399 (AddPicture), :548-556; TV DEVLOG v2.155 1341-1346; VV PdfExporter__.js:211,224,310
findings.vv_adaptation: Keep VV's paint path until WP-S08-14

findings.title: jsPDF is vendored inside the legacy 35__System__PageLayoutSystem; TV moved it to the version-locked vendor folder
findings.detail: VV injects jsPDF from 02__Src__AppModules/35__System__PageLayoutSystem/01__Dependencies__VersionLocked/jspdf.umd.js (AppConfig :402, SheetSetup fallback :396, two test harnesses). TV moved its copy to 04__Lib__ThirdParty__VersionLocked/05__Vendor__JsPdf__v4.1.0 in v2.155 Phase 0. Both are jsPDF 4.1.0 and identical after CRLF normalisation (1,201,529 vs 1,234,402 bytes).
findings.recommendation: Copy the file to VV/04__Lib__ThirdParty__VersionLocked/05__Vendor__JsPdf__v4.1.0/ and update the four strings and the version-lock README (05 is not in the coordinated 3D set). Leave the 35 copy until 35 is retired.

findings.title: VV client utility for published files (03__AppUtils), not a VV 80__CloudflareIntegration folder
findings.detail: TV's Published client is a region of its CfApi client (ApiClient 977-1175: PublishedLocation, ListPublished, UploadPublished raw with a base64 fallback, DeletePublished). By design (DIV-4) VV keeps its R2 clients in 03__AppUtils: R2SaveProjectJson, R2AssetUpload and R2DrawingNotes, all using the X-Editor-Api-Key worker with the config from Flask.
findings.recommendation: New VVM/03__AppUtils/Na__AppUtils__R2PublishedDocs__.js with IsConfigured, Upload (raw POST, type from the extension), List (paginated) and Delete (document-scoped), reusing Na__AppUtils__R2FetchWorkerConfig.

findings.title: VV Flask returns index.html with HTTP 200 for any missing file
findings.detail: serve_static falls back to index.html for every missing path. The reader's rule 'a 404 is an answer' cannot work on VV localhost: a missing published JSON is misread (then falls through), and a missing tier picture becomes a broken <image>, because Urls.Direct hands out only the first URL.
findings.recommendation: In WP-S08-05, return a real 404 for missing files under /Projects/, or serve published files through the new blueprint.

findings.title: Reader URL order on VV localhost must start with the Flask-served copy
findings.detail: TV's Urls.For puts ResolveAssetUrl's fallback first on localhost. In TV that fallback is the same-origin repository copy; in VV it is the GitHub Pages URL. Ported verbatim, VV's reader would ask GitHub Pages first and then show the previously pushed R2 copy after a local publish.
findings.recommendation: VV seam in Na__PubDoc__Urls__.For: on localhost try ${origin}/Projects/{folderId}/{path} (Flask static) first, then R2, then GitHub Pages. The live order is unchanged (R2, then GH).

findings.title: VV ProjectLoader lacks GetProjectFolderFromUrl/GetYearFromUrl, which 52, 65 and 66 import
findings.detail: TV reads ?project-folder= and ?year= (2-digit, default '26'). VV reads ?project=<code|folder|folderId> and resolves it through the R2 master index to '2026/3047__Doous'. Five TV files import the two TV helpers: Publish__, Transport, Urls, Share__Links and Share__Manifest.
findings.recommendation: Add VV-meaning facades to VVM/03__AppUtils/Na__AppUtils__ProjectLoader.js returning the folder part and 4-digit year of NormalizeProjectFolderId(GetProjectCodeFromUrl()). The ported files then keep their imports. Document this as a DIV-4 seam.
findings.vv_adaptation: Same names, VV meaning (4-digit year from the master index)

findings.title: VV SheetSurface lacks ShowPublished and ZOOM_SETTLED_EVENT
findings.detail: TV SheetSurface 1.13.0 exports ShowPublished (:476-503: the same paper with a published host, the editor sheet parked, Refresh inert) and ZOOM_SETTLED_EVENT (1.10.0, v2.111). VV 1.6.0 has neither. It also has no single layer Stack: Frames, ChromeSvg, MarkupSvg, FocusSvg and Handles are separate elements.
findings.recommendation: Add an adapted ShowPublished to VV's SheetSurface (hide VV's own layers), or take it with the SheetSurface slice. Until ZOOM_SETTLED_EVENT exists, swap tiers on ZOOM_EVENT debounced by Tiers__SwapDebounceMs (220 ms).
findings.evidence: TVM/LE/10__Core__SheetSurface/Na__LayoutEditor__SheetSurface__.js:235,458-503,1040-1062 exports; VV same file :155-174, exports (no ShowPublished/ZOOM_SETTLED)
findings.vv_adaptation: Hide VV's separate layer elements instead of TV's Stack

findings.title: VV loader would hold its screen 2.5 s for renders that never come in the published viewer
findings.detail: The VV loader keeps its screen up through Na__LeMode__WaitForFirstDrawing, which waits on Na__LeVeil__DrawingSettled(viewportCount). A published viewer renders nothing, so the wait ends only at GIVEUP_MS (2,500 ms), stacked on top of the published loading cover. TV has no loader, so there is no TV counterpart.
findings.recommendation: In viewer mode WaitForFirstDrawing resolves at once and the PubLoad cover owns the wait. This is a VV seam, recorded in the VV ledger.

findings.title: Share entry points and start-up wiring in VV
findings.detail: TV places Share in: the dock (WebViewer 1.2.0); the toolbar after Download PDF (Toolbar 1.24.0 :576-582); after Print in the specification's Read view (SpecEditor Bar 1.4.0 :204-210). Share__Open starts from Index.html :1733-1738, and the CSS is imported by the CSS index. VV loads the editor lazily, links its CSS via the loader, and has neither the na-app-scene-ready event nor Na__DrawData__IsLoaded.
findings.recommendation: Buttons in the VV Toolbar (:355) and SpecEditor Bar (:184-187). CSS in Na__LeLoad__STYLESHEETS before the WebViewer sheet. The loader starts Share__Open only when ?open= is present. Dispatch na-app-scene-ready in VV's LoadingSequence; add IsLoaded to VV 42/ProjectData.
findings.vv_adaptation: Loader-started Open; CSS via the loader list

findings.title: VV share link form: no s/ or q/ resolver exists, and none is needed
findings.detail: TV hands out https://www.noble-architecture.com/s/?<code>&open=<key>, which the website's s/index.html resolves through q/index.json (written by the ProjectVision build script). VV has no such website folders. But VV's ?project= already accepts a bare code and resolves it through the R2 master index, which a project rename updates.
findings.recommendation: D-S08-05 option (a): Link__BaseUrl = the VV live app (GitHub Pages ValeVision3D index.html), pattern ?project={projectCode}&open={documentKey}, with the same keys and open parameter. Build a short resolver only if Vale moves to its own domain.

findings.title: Where VV's published documents live
findings.detail: TV root: NaProjectPortal/<yy>-Projects/<folder>/30__TrueVision__AppContent/06__Layout__PublishedDocuments/. VV keeps project assets directly in VaApps/Projects/{folderId}/ (PresentationMode/Thumbnails, LayoutEditor/Linework, LayoutEditor/Snapshots). VV's ResolveAssetUrl is relative to that folder, so 53's relative paths would land at VaApps/Projects/{folderId}/06__Layout__PublishedDocuments/ with no code change.

findings.title: Publish write order: TV is local-first with R2 optional; VV's convention is R2-first
findings.detail: TV publishes locally first and goes to R2 only on a deliberate tick: verify sizes, then the manifest, then the index last. Archives stay local. VV's rule is 'R2 = SSOT, Flask mirror second'. The publish pipeline's guarantees (archive before replace, verify before manifest, document-scoped prune, index last) depend on TV's order.
findings.recommendation: D-S08-02 option (a): keep TV's order for publishing only, recorded as a deliberate exception. A published document is a deliverable built and reviewed locally before a client can see it.

findings.title: The shared Vale service worker has no published cache class

Ledger row 1189 wrongly says VV has no service worker.
findings.recommendation: Add a wpwa-published- class: patterns, owned prefix and activate keep-list. Bump the token with the release; that is Adam's call, because a bump evicts every Vale app's caches (D-S08-10).

Each makes the importing module fail to link.

decisions_needed.question: Where do VV's published documents live?
decisions_needed.options: (a) VaApps/Projects/{folderId}/06__Layout__PublishedDocuments/ on R2 and WCP/Projects/{folderId}/06__... locally, keeping the schema names verbatim; (b) .../LayoutEditor/PublishedDocuments/ to match VV's LayoutEditor/Linework|Snapshots, which changes Folders__Root in the shared contract
decisions_needed.recommendation: (a). The schema stays identical in both apps and needs no code change, because VV's project-relative root is the project folder.

decisions_needed.question: Which write order does VV publishing use?
decisions_needed.options: (a) TV's: local first, R2 only on a deliberate tick, verify, manifest last, index last; (b) VV's R2-first two-phase convention
decisions_needed.recommendation: (a), recorded as a deliberate exception to VV's R2-first rule. The rule is about project data; a published document is a reviewed deliverable.

decisions_needed.question: Which typeface do VV sheets and PDFs use?
decisions_needed.options: (a) port PdfFonts and embed Open Sans (VV D14, VV's screen face) from a VV-owned copy, switch the sheet face to Open Sans-first and re-measure the title block; (b) a Vale brand typeface (no files in the repositories; needs files and a licence); (c) keep non-embedded Helvetica (ledger 1169 status quo)
decisions_needed.recommendation: (a). (c) leaves every Vale PDF rendering in a different face in each reader, and screen annotations differing from print. The published reader's font must match whatever is chosen.

decisions_needed.question: Where is Publish Drawings opened in VV, given there is no Drawing Register?
decisions_needed.options: (a) port the Drawing Register (another slice) and use its bar, as TV does; (b) an interim entry in the Layout Editor Dev section (localhost only); (c) a toolbar button
decisions_needed.recommendation: (a) for an identical experience, with (b) until the register lands.

decisions_needed.question: What link form does VV's Share hand out?
decisions_needed.options: (a) <VV live app URL>?project=<code>&open=<key>, resolved by VV's R2 master index, with base and pattern in config; (b) a short resolver page like TV's s/ on a Vale-controlled host
decisions_needed.recommendation: (a) now. (b) only if Vale moves to its own domain: the base is config, but the keys are permanent.

decisions_needed.question: What is a VV document id (it names published folders, archives and the share fallback)?
decisions_needed.options: (a) the stored Drawing No., sanitised, falling back to VV's '<code>-<order>' default; (b) TV's three-fact composition (project code + phase + number), only together with the register/phase port
decisions_needed.recommendation: (a) as an interim adapter, decided before the first publish. A later change of id creates new folders and archives the old ones.

decisions_needed.question: How do VV's share and viewer treat statements and the register?
decisions_needed.options: (a) omit both kinds now and keep the key constants reserved; (b) hold sharing until the Statement Writer and Register are ported

decisions_needed.question: Is published output committed to the ValeCodebase repo?
decisions_needed.options: (a) ignore Projects/**/06__Layout__PublishedDocuments/ (R2 is the reader's source; GitHub Pages then has no fallback copy); (b) commit everything except 00__Archive__Revisions; (c) commit all
decisions_needed.recommendation: (a) or (b). Never commit archive zips (TV's own '**/00__Archive/' rule misses '00__Archive__Revisions' too).

decisions_needed.question: How should the shared Whitecardopedia sync purge be fixed?
decisions_needed.options: (a) purge top-level keys only (Delimiter='/') and paginate; (b) skip named prefixes (06__Layout__PublishedDocuments/, LayoutEditor/, PresentationMode/, 00__)
decisions_needed.recommendation: (a), which matches the function's stated intent. It must precede VV's first R2 publish.

decisions_needed.question: Should the shared Vale service worker get a published cache class and a token bump?
decisions_needed.options: (a) yes, with the publishing release; (b) no class, relying on HTTP cache headers
decisions_needed.recommendation: (a). The bump is Adam's call because it evicts every Vale app's caches.

decisions_needed.question: Should 65 and PdfExporter wait for the dependency slices, or be stubbed to get the phone-safe reader sooner?
decisions_needed.options: (a) wait, then port verbatim; (b) stub RenderFogForExport/SitePlanDrawing/IsSitePlan* now (fog and site plans only)
decisions_needed.recommendation: (a). (b) only for fog and site plans; PaintOrder, BuildLayerPrimitives, BuildViewportFrame and FloorAreas cannot be stubbed without changing the published sheet.

decisions_needed.question: What upload mode and size ceiling does the new worker route use?
decisions_needed.options: (a) raw streamed body up to about 95 MB; (b) base64 JSON like the existing asset route (25 MB, whole file in Worker memory)
